cnpcef.gui.battle_desire.tooltip: Range: 0–10; default: 5. Higher values shorten melee waiting and speed up EF attacks. 0 gives ordinary CNPC melee an extremely long wait (about 2.1 billion ticks), while EF attack animations remain at half speed; it is not a universal attack disable. Does not change damage or add skill slots.
cnpcef.gui.anim_speed.tooltip: Range: 0.01–10; default: 1. Multiplies EF melee attack animation speed and collision timing. 2 is twice as fast; 0.5 is half speed. Does not change damage or ranged attacks.
cnpcef.configuration.npcDamageUseMeleeSt: Enabled by default: use CNPC's melee attack value without EF weapon/animation damage stacking. Armor, resistance, blocking, scripts and faction protection still apply. Excludes projectiles and executions. Disable for the legacy weapon-stacking model. Saving takes effect immediately on this logical server; remote server settings must be edited on that server.
cnpcef.configuration.attackDiagnostics.t: Disabled by default to avoid high-volume attack logs. Enable temporarily when diagnosing combat. Saving takes effect immediately.
cnpcef.configuration.npcFactionFriendlyF: NPC attacks cannot damage NPCs whose faction is not hostile to the attacker. Does not affect ordinary mobs. Saving takes effect immediately on this logical server.
cnpcef.configuration.npcPlayerFactionPro: Friendly NPC factions cannot damage players. Neutral NPCs may damage a player only when that player is their attack target. Saving takes effect immediately on this logical server.
cnpcef.configuration.playerStunImmuneArm: Armor threshold for NPC stun immunity
Default: 30 armor points. At or above this threshold, the player is immune to NPC-inflicted stun. Set to 0 or below to disable immunity. Saving takes effect immediately on this logical server.
cnpcef.configuration.armorStunBenefitPos: True: more armor shortens variable-duration stun; false: it lengthens it. Fixed-duration animation types keep Epic Fight's timing. Saving takes effect immediately on this logical server.
cnpcef.configuration.npcAttackSpeedUseMe: Legacy option, disabled by default. Enabled: EF attack speed uses 20 / CNPC melee delay (ticks). Disabled: use EF weapon attack speed. Battle desire and animation multiplier still apply. Saving takes effect immediately.
